62: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
63: 	}

66: 		FlagUsageType utilityClassFlag = errorNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE);
67: 		FlagUsageType experimentalFlag = errorNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.EXPERIMENTAL_FLAG_USAGE);
68: 		FlagUsageType flaggedUsage = null;
69: 		String flaggedFeature = null;
70: 		if (utilityClassFlag == FlagUsageType.ERROR) {
71: 			flaggedUsage = utilityClassFlag;
72: 			flaggedFeature = "@UtilityClass";
73: 		} else if (experimentalFlag == FlagUsageType.ERROR) {
74: 			flaggedUsage = experimentalFlag;
75: 			flaggedFeature = "any lombok.experimental feature";
76: 		} else if (utilityClassFlag == FlagUsageType.WARNING) {
77: 			flaggedUsage = utilityClassFlag;
78: 			flaggedFeature = "@UtilityClass";
79: 		} else {

81: 			flaggedFeature = "any lombok.experimental feature";
82: 		}

86: 			else if (flaggedUsage == FlagUsageType.ERROR) errorNode.addError(flaggedMessage);
87: 		}
88: 		if (utilityClassFlag == null && AllowHelper.isAllowable(ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE)) {
89: 			errorNode.addError("Use of @UtilityClass is disabled by default. Please add '" + ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE.getKeyName() + " = " + FlagUsageType.ALLOW + "' to 'lombok.config' if you want to enable is.");
90: 		}
91: 
92: 		if (!inNetbeansEditor(errorNode) && errorNode.shouldDeleteLombokAnnotations()) {
93: 			JavacNode annotatedNode = errorNode.directUp();
94: 			if (annotatedNode.getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
95: 				try {
96: 					JCClassDecl annotatedType = (JCClassDecl) annotatedNode.get();
97: 					ListBuffer<JCAnnotation> remainingAnnotations = new ListBuffer<JCAnnotation>();
98: 					for (JCAnnotation existingAnnotation : annotatedType.mods.annotations) {
99: 						if (existingAnnotation != errorNode.get()) remainingAnnotations.append(existingAnnotation);
100: 					}
101: 					annotatedType.mods.annotations = remainingAnnotations.toList();
102: 				} catch (ClassCastException ex) {

104: 				}

106: 				deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(errorNode, UtilityClass.class.getName());
107: 			}
108: 		}

110: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
111: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
112: 			return;
113: 		}

115: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
116: 		while (true) {
117: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
118: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
119: 			case TYPE:
120: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
121: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
122: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) break;
123: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
124: 				return;
125: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
126: 				break;
127: 			default:
128: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");

130: 			}

132: 		}

135: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
136: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
137: 
138: 		boolean markStatic = true;
139: 		if (typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) markStatic = false;

141: 			JCClassDecl typeDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.up().get();
142: 			if ((typeDecl.mods.flags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) markStatic = false;
143: 		}
144: 		if (markStatic) classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;

147: 			if (element.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {

150: 				long staticFieldFlags = fieldFlags | Flags.STATIC;
151: 				fieldDecl.mods.flags = staticFieldFlags;

175: 			}

183: 			List<JCExpression> noTypeArgs = List.nil();
184: 			JCExpression message = maker.Literal("This is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
185: 			List<JCExpression> exceptionArgs = List.of(message);
186: 			JCExpression exceptionInstance = maker.NewClass(null, noTypeArgs, exceptionType, exceptionArgs, null);
187: 			JCStatement throwStatement = maker.Throw(exceptionInstance);
188: 			List<JCStatement> constructorBody = List.of(throwStatement);

191: 			List<JCVariableDecl> noParams = List.nil();
192: 			List<JCExpression> noThrown = List.nil();

195: 			injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
196: 		}
197: 	}
